editorial:
Get ready for a wild ride back to Ohio because Baggy is back and meaner than ever. You will follow the creepy killer as he rents a garage from a couple named Marvin and Illsa, which quickly turns into a total bloodbath. It is a messy mix of scary kills and silly jokes that feels like a party from the nineties. You have Sheriff McBooney trying to keep the town safe, but he is way out of his league until FBI Agent Starline shows up to help him track down the monster.

You will love how the movie doesn't take itself too seriously, and the practical gore effects are actually pretty impressive for the time. While some of the dialogue feels a bit cheesy, that is mostly part of the charm. If you like slashers that make you laugh and scream at the same time, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the blood in high detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After a long chase, Sheriff McBooney finally corners Baggy in the garage. Following Agent Starline's plan, McBooney manages to trap the killer and deliver a final, deadly blow that seems to end the nightmare. The town celebrates their victory and thinks they are safe. However, the very last shot shows Baggy's mask lying on the floor and then slowly moving, suggesting that the killer survived and will come back again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school slasher movies and dark humor.
